prompts.rung-6-off-world:
Look first: mark empire_ready is true (economy:econ-checklist).
Do: ladder_set mark space_program_open true, then speak one clean line to chat.
Fallback: speak refused -> still set the mark; the chat line is optional.
Done: mark space_program_open true; latch rung_6_off_world_done.
Owner: "dominate the universe with a space ewarfare and planet domination".
Owner: "be greedy you empire is the goal" ... "you want armies defences turrets all of it".
prompts.space-microelectronics:
Look first: research_current, research_microelectronicsbasics.
If MicroelectronicsBasics is already the current project: nothing to do.
Do: queue MicroelectronicsBasics (Research tab, game_take_screenshot, game_click_ui_target it); pawn_priorities best brain Research=1.
Refused / no bench: hand back to production; the rung retries next scan.
Done: research_microelectronicsbasics true (the rung goes dark).
Owner: "you have to research microelelectronics to get trade beacons".
prompts.space-trade-beacon:
Look first: game_list_zones -- every storage room.
Do: game_select_architect_designator OrbitalTradeBeacon, apply one INSIDE each storage room (range = its own room).
Refused: check has_power, steel, components; screenshot, move one cell, retry.
Never: corridor stockpiles; plant matter goes to the freezer.
Done: every storage room has a powered beacon -> ladder_set mark trade_beacons_cover true.
Owner: "all storage zones and shelfes and items are withing a orbital trade beacon".
prompts.space-ally-gifts:
Look first: transport_pods, pod_launchers, silver >= 1000.
Do: load a pod with silver, launch it at a friendly settlement as a gift (gizmos Load, then Launch).
Refused (no fuel / no friendly tile): skip; the rung fires again next scan.
Done: ladder_set mark gift_sent true (cooldown rung clears it in 15 days).
Owner: "making all factions you can your allies by send gifts with drop pods".
prompts.space-ally-gifts-cooldown:
Timer only: gift_sent has held 15 days.
Do: ladder_set mark gift_sent false.
Fallback: none needed.
Done: gift_sent false -> space-ally-gifts may fire.
Owner: "send gifts with drop pods".
prompts.grav-core:
Look first: game_list_letters for quests rewarding a grav engine / gravcore.
Do: game_open_letter, accept.
Fallback: no such quest -> nothing; the rung waits on quest_letter.
Done: gravcore on the map -> ladder_set mark gravcore_found true.
Owner: "drop poding down from your megaship to a tribal village".
prompts.grav-build:
Look first: game_list_architect_designators Odyssey category (never guess names).
Do: substructure, engine, thrusters, fuel storage, pilot console; move barracks/freezer/workshop/turrets on.
Refused placement: game_take_screenshot, move one cell, retry.
Done: grav_parts >= GRAV_PARTS_TARGET (the rung goes dark).
Owner: "an empire space domination run".
prompts.grav-ready:
Look first: grav_parts at target, fuel level.
Do: fill fuel, select the pilot console, game_list_selected_gizmos for launch prerequisites.
Missing prerequisite: build or fuel it, check again.
Done: no prerequisite missing -> ladder_set mark gravship_ready true.
Owner: "drop poding down from your megaship".
prompts.megaship-drop:
Look first: mark war_target_set, mark gravship_ready.
Do: fly near the target tile, pod assault from the ship's launchers, cavalry by caravan.
Tile pick refused / no tool: reply_owner and wait.
Done: latch megaship_drop_done.
Owner: "capture prisoners and rule the world. have you even looked at the world yet?"
prompts.space-ask-chat:
Do: twitch_chat, ask (clean) which space move is next.
Then: ladder_set mark space_chat_asked true.
No answer within a game hour: keep climbing.
Done: space_chat_asked true (cooldown clears it after a day).
Owner: "if they done answer just keep toward your goals of empire world domination and space warfare".
prompts.space-ask-chat-cooldown:
Timer only: space_chat_asked has held 24 hours.
Do: ladder_set mark space_chat_asked false.
Fallback: none needed.
Done: space-ask-chat may ask again.
Owner: "if they done answer just keep toward your goals".
